factories.name: new_search_conversations_step
factories.description: List one page of up to 25 conversations filtered by inbox, Help Scout status, tag, customer email, and modification time, with the next page number.

inputSchema.description: SearchConversationsInput filters Help Scout conversations. Filters narrow each other, and a blank or zero filter applies no restriction, so an empty input lists active conversations in every inbox the app's Help Scout user can access.

customerEmail.description: CustomerEmail matches conversations where the address is in To, Cc, or Bcc or is one of a customer profile's emails, as Help Scout's email search documents, such as jane@example.com.

mailboxId.description: MailboxID limits the search to one inbox, such as the mailboxPicker unit's mailboxId; zero searches every inbox.

modifiedSince.description: ModifiedSince matches conversations modified after this RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset, such as 2026-01-21T00:00:00Z. Help Scout compares whole seconds. Blank applies no time filter.

page.description: Page is the 1-based page to read, at most MaxSearchPage; zero reads page 1. Pass a previous result's NextPage to continue.

status.description: Status is active, pending, closed, spam, or all. Blank lists active conversations, Help Scout's default.

tag.description: Tag limits the search to conversations carrying this tag name.

factories.name: new_get_conversation_step
factories.description: Read one conversation by ID with a bounded list of its newest threads.

inputSchema.description: GetConversationInput names one conversation and how many of its newest threads to return.

conversationId.description: ConversationID is the Help Scout conversation ID, not the conversation number shown to users.

threadLimit.description: ThreadLimit is 1 to MaxThreadLimit newest threads; zero returns DefaultThreadLimit.

factories.name: new_reply_to_conversation_step
factories.description: Add one customer reply, which Help Scout emails, or one internal note to a conversation. Help Scout has no idempotency key; the single-dispatch fence requires sync durability so retry attempts can read its heartbeat checkpoint before deciding whether to send.

inputSchema.description: ReplyToConversationInput is one customer reply or internal note to add to a conversation.

conversationId.description: ConversationID is the Help Scout conversation ID.

customerId.description: CustomerID is the customer a reply is sent to. Zero reads the conversation first and uses its primary customer; a note must leave it zero.

isInternalNote.description: IsInternalNote adds a note that only the team sees, through POST /v2/conversations/{id}/notes. False adds a reply that Help Scout emails to the customer, through POST /v2/conversations/{id}/reply.

status.description: Status sets the conversation's status with the thread: active, pending, closed, or spam. Blank keeps Help Scout's default, under which a reply reactivates the conversation.

text.description: Text is the reply or note, sent unchanged as Help Scout's thread text; Help Scout stores thread bodies as HTML. It is required and at most MaxReplyTextBytes.

factories.name: new_update_conversation_step
factories.description: Set the Help Scout status or assignee of one conversation and add or remove tags; a repeated attempt finds the values already applied and writes nothing.

inputSchema.description: UpdateConversationInput is one change to an existing conversation. Blank and zero fields are left unchanged; at least one change is required.

addTags.description: AddTags adds tags and keeps the conversation's other tags; a tag that does not exist is created.

assigneeId.description: AssigneeID assigns a Help Scout user or team, which share one ID space. Zero keeps the assignee.

conversationId.description: ConversationID is the Help Scout conversation ID.

isUnassigned.description: IsUnassigned removes the assignee; it cannot be combined with AssigneeID.

removeTags.description: RemoveTags removes tags and keeps the conversation's other tags.

status.description: Status is the new status: active, pending, closed, or spam. Blank keeps the status.

factories.name: new_find_customer_by_email_step
factories.description: Find the Help Scout customer profiles whose email matches one address, returning every match so the Flow decides between duplicates.

inputSchema.description: FindCustomerByEmailInput names one email address to look up.

email.description: Email is one bare address, such as jane@example.com.
